quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
حمٓ
تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ
وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍۢ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
يَسْمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
هَٰذَا هُدًۭى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ
أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءًۭ مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۢ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةًۭ فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍۢ جَاثِيَةًۭ ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۢ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ
وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
وَقِيلَ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًۭا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

parent_channels.name: Circulation Across Sky, Earth, and Sea (P1: 45:1-14)

subchannels.name: Rain Descends Into Living Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is lowered from the overhead sky as allotted provision, enters receptive soil, and converts dead land into growth.
subchannels.active_motifs: downward alighting (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); caused descent of rain (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m02`); rain as provision (`quranic:root_000560:B003/m01`); earth revived by rain (`quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`); uncultivated dead land (`quranic:root_001454:B003/m01`); soft fertile soil (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`); rain-bearing overhead sky (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: The downward motion is a causal chain rather than a juxtaposition of natural objects. What descends is already construed as nourishment; the ground is a receptive material, and revival is the observable outcome. The lexical image of dead, unused land makes resurrection concrete as restored productivity.

subchannels.name: Harnessed Current Carries the Vessel
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wind and water are directed into a navigable current that bears a vessel toward sought bounty.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad body of water (`quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`); flowing water, wind, and ship (`quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`); vessel moving on water (`quranic:root_001177:B003/m01`); wave moving back and forth (`quranic:root_001177:B007/m01`); wind and moving air (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`); directed shifting of winds and currents (`quranic:root_000860:B002/m01`); harnessing and facilitation (`quranic:root_000685:B001/m01`); purposeful seeking (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); unowed bounty (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The sea is a field, the wind and current are instruments, the ship is the carried object, and bounty is the destination. Subjection therefore materializes as controlled transmission of force rather than inert possession.

subchannels.name: Alternating Cycles Keep the System Moving
subchannels.scene_or_process: Day and night exchange places while winds, work, and celestial motion turn in corresponding cycles.
subchannels.active_motifs: succession by alternation (`quranic:root_000433:B006/m01`); night and its darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); daylight opening in brightness (`quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`); vicissitudes and temporal turns (`quranic:root_000860:B007/m01`); alternating turns in work (`quranic:root_000609:B008/m01`); circular motion (`quranic:root_001177:B001/m01`); celestial orbit (`quranic:root_001177:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Alternating time, shifting air, and the circular lexical reach of `فُلْك` form one recurrent-motion mechanism. The ship in 45:12 also resonates with an orbit, so navigation below mirrors regulated revolution above.

subchannels.name: Dispersal Becomes Hidden Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Created life is scattered over the ground, advances by visible creeping and hidden permeation, then appears as shoots and renewed foliage.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattering and spreading living things (`quranic:root_000083:B001/m01`); creeping over the ground (`quranic:root_000457:B001/m01`); imperceptible permeation (`quranic:root_000457:B003/m01`); creative origination (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); small input producing a visible response (`quranic:root_000810:B002/m01`); emerging shoots (`quranic:root_000810:B004/m01`); renewed foliage (`quranic:root_000609:B017/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Dissemination is followed beneath perception by a subtler kind of movement, then disclosed in fresh growth. The vegetative senses of gratitude make response itself organic: a little provision is acknowledged by becoming visibly fruitful.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Ordered motion transfers water, air, bodies, and living force from a source through a channel into a productive destination.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The signs are not static objects but a coordinated transport system in which descent, current, alternation, dispersal, and germination are different scales of one circulation.

parent_channels.name: Message Transmission and Receptive Surfaces (P1: 45:1-14)

subchannels.name: The Ordered Mark Becomes a Following Voice
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written composition is lowered into its proper order, presented as a visible mark, and voiced in a sequence that guides its hearer.
subchannels.active_motifs: composed written record (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); caused descent of scripture (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); placement in a proper rank (`quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`); manifest sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); ordered following (`quranic:root_000186:B001/m01`); one voice following another (`quranic:root_000186:B007/m01`); renewed speech or report (`quranic:root_000299:B003/m01`); gentle direction to the path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Writing supplies stable marks, descent assigns them a place, and recitation releases them as a temporal chain. The same material is thus document, sign, following voice, and guide without collapsing those operations into a generic speech theme.

subchannels.name: Hearing Is Tied Off Into Refusal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sound reaches the ear, but comprehension is arrested by a binding resolve, self-elevation, covering, diversion, and mockery.
subchannels.active_motifs: auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); understanding that issues in obedience (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); binding and knotting (`quranic:root_000856:B001/m01`); fixed resolve and persistence (`quranic:root_000856:B002/m01`); human self-exaltation (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`); covering that hides (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); turning a thing from its proper direction (`quranic:root_000041:B001/m01`); ridicule (`quranic:root_001587:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The failure occurs after acoustic contact. A knot converts persistence into blockage; pride supplies the posture, covering suppresses disclosure, and diversion turns the received sign away from its intended course.

subchannels.name: The Proclamation Reaches the Skin
subchannels.scene_or_process: An announced outcome passes from speech to bodily surface and is completed as felt and inflicted pain.
subchannels.active_motifs: exposed skin or surface (`quranic:root_000120:B001/m01`); news that opens or changes the skin (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`); felt pain (`quranic:root_000046:B001/m01`); causing pain (`quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`); punitive suffering (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The ironic proclamation of punishment is not only verbal. The branch imagery lets news register on the body's outer surface and then pass inward as sensation, giving the announcement a concrete terminal medium.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A message moves through ordered marks and voices into a receiver, where it is either understood, physically blocked, or impressed on the body.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Recitation behaves like a following chain, refusal like a tightened knot and covering, and proclamation like news that alters the skin.

parent_channels.name: False Shelter and Protective Covering (P1: 45:1-14)

subchannels.name: Possessions and Allies Form a Failed Rear Shelter
subchannels.scene_or_process: Acquired goods and chosen allies are placed as protection behind or beside their holder, but fail to stand in for what is needed.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealment behind a visible front (`quranic:root_001642:B005/m01`); the rear or other side (`quranic:root_001642:B006/m01`); allied protection (`quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`); sufficiency in place of another (`quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`); self-acquired possession (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); earned gain (`quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`); a lesser substitute other than the goal (`quranic:root_000502:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene arranges wealth and patrons as a defensive layer, then removes their substitutive force. What has been taken, earned, and placed behind the subject cannot become an adequate cover.

subchannels.name: Forgiveness Covers Until Recompense
subchannels.scene_or_process: Offense is covered so that its immediate effect does not strike the offender, while earned action remains assigned to a later reciprocal settlement.
subchannels.active_motifs: protective covering (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`); covering sin and shielding its bearer from the effect (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); reciprocal recompense (`quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`); earned gain (`quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`); hoped-for expectation (`quranic:root_000548:B001/m01`); a decisive event or ordeal (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Forgiveness is a real protective operation, not erasure of the moral account. It suspends exposure at the interpersonal level while recompense remains attached to what a group earns.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Covering mediates exposure to consequence, either as an ineffective hiding place or as protection from the effect of wrongdoing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same spatial logic distinguishes assets and allies placed behind a person from forgiveness that actually covers an offense before recompense.

parent_channels.name: Vertical Rank and Moral Reversal (P1: 45:1-14)

subchannels.name: Height Is Stabilized by Power and Precision
subchannels.scene_or_process: The elevated sky and lower ground form a vertical order governed by strength, accurate wisdom, and structural precision.
subchannels.active_motifs: height and elevation (`quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`); overhead sky and canopy (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); the lower ground opposite the sky (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); strength and inviolable dignity (`quranic:root_001008:B001/m01`); wisdom that reaches the right judgment (`quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`); precise and secure construction (`quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Vertical space is presented as an ordered structure, not an empty backdrop. Power secures it and wisdom gives it right proportion, so cosmic height supplies the legitimate model of rank.

subchannels.name: Inflated Height Ends in Humiliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person enlarges his own rank, while punishment reassigns magnitude to the consequence and lowers the claimant into humiliation.
subchannels.active_motifs: human self-exaltation (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`); greatness and magnitude (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); abasement by contempt (`quranic:root_001608:B003/m01`); punitive suffering (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The offender's attempted enlargement is not merely condemned; its scale is transferred. The consequence becomes `عَظِيم`, while the self-elevated subject receives `مُّهِين`, producing a precise role reversal.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Height, force, and magnitude establish rank, but self-assigned elevation is inverted into abasement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic above-and-below relations become the scale by which human inflation is exposed and reversed.

parent_channels.name: Routes Chosen After Guidance (P2: 45:15-26)

subchannels.name: Law Opens as a Watering Route
subchannels.scene_or_process: A clear road brings travelers to an open water source; entering it and following its traces sustains directed movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: public approach to water (`quranic:root_000789:B002/m01`); entering and undertaking an affair (`quranic:root_000789:B003/m01`); following a person, order, or trace (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); tracing an imprint step by step (`quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`); prophecy as a clear road (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`); gentle guidance to a path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `شريعة` supplies the setting and access point, prophecy supplies the road, command supplies direction, and following supplies locomotion. The legal image is therefore a maintained approach to life-giving access rather than an abstract rule set.

subchannels.name: Knowledge Forks Into Rival Paths
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clear evidence arrives, but participants leave a shared course, cross proper limits, and await a verdict that cuts through their divergence.
subchannels.active_motifs: disclosure as clear proof (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); knowledge disclosed to the knower (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); each party taking a different path (`quranic:root_000433:B004/m01`); transgressive crossing of a limit (`quranic:root_000138:B003/m01`); decisive judgment (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The problem is not absence of a route but branching after disclosure. Divergence gives the spatial operation, transgression explains the crossing, and judgment is the terminal act that resolves the fork.

subchannels.name: Desire Pulls the Follower Into a Hollow Fall
subchannels.scene_or_process: A follower substitutes inward inclination for guidance; the directing medium proves hollow and becomes a downward trajectory into loss of the path.
subchannels.active_motifs: appetite and inward inclination (`quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`); empty air and an unsteady heart (`quranic:root_001609:B001/m01`); falling into an abyss (`quranic:root_001609:B002/m01`); following another's course (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); straying from the intended road (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); gentle guidance to the path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Desire is both the chosen guide and an empty space incapable of bearing weight. Following it thus changes from horizontal imitation into vertical descent, sharpening the contrast between a supplied route and self-directed appetite.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Knowledge presents a traversable route, while following, divergence, transgression, and desire determine where the traveler ends.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Law becomes a public watering approach, prophecy a clear road, disagreement a physical fork, and desire an empty medium that tips the follower into a fall.

parent_channels.name: Open Insight and the Sealed Sensorium (P2: 45:15-26)

subchannels.name: Insight Equips the Knower
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inward sight becomes a protective instrument, with guidance, mercy, and certainty orienting and defending its bearer.
subchannels.active_motifs: penetrating insight of the heart (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); shield or armor (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`); guidance to the right path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); merciful care (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); stable knowledge beyond doubt (`quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `بصائر` are simultaneously inward vision and, lexically, protective equipment. Guidance gives direction, mercy supplies care, and certainty stabilizes the equipped perceiver.

subchannels.name: Stamp, Seal, and Veil Close the Instruments
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hearing, heart, and sight are treated as apertures and surfaces that can be stamped, secured against access, and covered.
subchannels.active_motifs: imprint of a stamp (`quranic:root_000393:B002/m01`); securing seal that prevents access (`quranic:root_000393:B003/m01`); auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); ear as the hearing aperture (`quranic:root_000741:B002/m01`); comprehension that should issue in obedience (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); heart as organ of understanding (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`); overlying veil (`quranic:root_001088:B001/m01`); visual perception (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); disappearance into hiddenness (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The seal supplies both an impressed mark and a fastening operation; the veil adds an outer layer. Hearing remains a component but loses its passage into obedient understanding, while sight and heart are likewise converted from channels into closed surfaces.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perception becomes guidance only when the bodily and inward instruments remain open; closure turns those same instruments into barriers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Insight can function as defensive armor, while the denied sensorium resembles a sealed document whose openings have been stamped and overlaid.

parent_channels.name: Acts Become Claims and Verdicts (P2: 45:15-26)

subchannels.name: The Personal Account Returns to Its Owner
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deliberate work is acquired by a self, creates an obligation, and returns through reciprocal settlement without withheld right.
subchannels.active_motifs: the self as identical bearer (`quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`); intended action (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`); earned acquisition (`quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`); reciprocal recompense (`quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`); return to an originating state or owner (`quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`); fixed obligation (`quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`); withholding a due right (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The self is not a generic person but the persistent identity that owns an act across time. Earning attaches the entry, obligation fixes it, return restores it to its bearer, and recompense settles it without detention of what is due.

subchannels.name: Incision Cannot Be Valued as Repair
subchannels.scene_or_process: Harmful acts are cut into the account like wounds, then subjected to a false calculation that tries to equalize injury and repair.
subchannels.active_motifs: incision and wound (`quranic:root_000233:B001/m01`); deliberate acquisition of deeds (`quranic:root_000233:B002/m01`); counting and calculation (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); unsupported assumption (`quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`); equalization of two sides (`quranic:root_000766:B001/m01`); adjudication between parties (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); moral ugliness (`quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`); repair opposed to corruption (`quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `اجترحوا` keeps its surface sense of acquired deeds while activating the image of a cut. Calculation then attempts to price wound and repair as equal conditions, exposing the judgment as a category error rather than a mere unfavorable opinion.

subchannels.name: Contested Proof Awaits a Cutting Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clear evidence enters a dispute, speakers advance a purported proof and truth claim, and a final judgment separates valid assertion from performance.
subchannels.active_motifs: disclosed evidence (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); prevailing proof in dispute (`quranic:root_000295:B003/m01`); truthful assertion (`quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`); fulfillment that verifies a claim (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); articulated statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); decisive judgment (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); truth fixed to reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The demand to produce the fathers is a courtroom maneuver: statement claims the status of proof, while truth requires enacted verification. The earlier decisive judgment supplies the terminal operation that the argument itself cannot perform.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Intended action creates an attributable entry that can be claimed, compared, judged, and reciprocally settled.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Wrongdoing is both acquisition and incision, equality is a disputed valuation, and the self is the legal identity to which the resulting account returns.

parent_channels.name: Life Continuity Against Extinction (P2: 45:15-26)

subchannels.name: Time's Attrition Meets Regathering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Extended time is imagined as a conquering force that stills and destroys living bodies, while a contrary agency gathers them from dispersal.
subchannels.active_motifs: time as conquering force (`quranic:root_000494:B001/m01`); extended duration (`quranic:root_000494:B002/m01`); loss of life and force (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); stillness and extinguishment (`quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`); animate life (`quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`); life as preservation and benefit (`quranic:root_000383:B013/m01`); destruction and disappearance (`quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`); gathering dispersed members (`quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The denial gives time an active role: it overpowers, stills, and erases. Gathering answers at the level of mechanism by reversing dispersal, while the life senses retain both animate force and preserved benefit.

subchannels.name: Womb, Lineage, and Fathers Form a Generative Chain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Lineage is built through a womb, childbirth, paternal nurture, arrival, and loss; the demand for the fathers points back into this material chain.
subchannels.active_motifs: sons and transmitted lineage (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); womb as the child's enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); childbirth and the newborn (`quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`); fatherhood and nurture (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`); arrival into presence (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); bringing or presenting another (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); a parent's loss of a child (`quranic:root_001454:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical field renders ancestry as embodied production rather than an inert list of predecessors. Asking that fathers be brought back invokes arrival at the far end of a process whose earlier stages already include enclosing, birthing, nurturing, and bereavement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life persists through generation, vital embodiment, and regathering despite the claim that time merely extinguishes successive bodies.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The resurrection dispute is pressured by a full generative chain of lineage, womb, childbirth, parenthood, loss, arrival, and collection.

parent_channels.name: Protection Through Adjacency and Custody (P2: 45:15-26)

subchannels.name: Wrongdoers Attach as Mutually Dependent Parts
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate parts fasten themselves into a protective bloc, yet their alliance cannot substitute for effective defense.
subchannels.active_motifs: parts cut from a whole (`quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`); adjacency without an interval (`quranic:root_001684:B001/m01`); allied aid (`quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`); withholding another's right (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`); failed sufficiency on another's behalf (`quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `بعضهم أولياء بعض` becomes a composite body whose pieces are close but not self-sufficient. Their relation supplies attachment and mutual claim, but not the power to stand in for one another before God.

subchannels.name: Custody Places a Shield Before the Exposed
subchannels.scene_or_process: A true guardian assumes charge and interposes a barrier, while the protected person actively places the self within that defense.
subchannels.active_motifs: custody and governance (`quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`); protective support (`quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`); barrier against harm (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); placing oneself in protection (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Guardianship is not simple proximity. It joins authority, support, an intervening barrier, and the protected subject's act of entering that guarded relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Nearness becomes protective only when an attached party can actually govern, shield, and answer for the exposed person.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mutual alliance resembles adjacent body-parts, but divine custody supplies the barrier that mere attachment lacks.

parent_channels.name: The Court's Living Record (P3: 45:27-37)

subchannels.name: Deeds Are Joined and Copied Into a Register
subchannels.scene_or_process: Discrete acts are gathered like joined material, written, entered under a name, and copied while the originating activity remains attributable.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining separate pieces (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); written composition (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); entry in a register or class (`quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`); copying a book while preserving its source (`quranic:root_001495:B002/m01`); intended action (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`); event made present in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Record-making is an assembly process: acts are not merely remembered but joined, inscribed, classified, and reproduced. Copying preserves a relation to an original, so the record remains evidence of the actor rather than an independent narrative.

subchannels.name: The Document Speaks as Proof
subchannels.scene_or_process: The completed record acquires a voice, discloses its meaning, and establishes truth before those made to see it.
subchannels.active_motifs: intelligible speech (`quranic:root_001519:B001/m01`); evidence that speaks for itself (`quranic:root_001519:B002/m01`); disclosure by statement or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); establishing and manifesting truth (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`); sight of the presented scene (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The record crosses media without losing identity: writing becomes articulate evidence. Its voice does not add a new claim but discloses and fixes the correspondence between recorded action and reality.

subchannels.name: Every Collective Is Summoned to Its File
subchannels.scene_or_process: A constituted group receives a public call, approaches its own register, and is paid for the totality of its work.
subchannels.active_motifs: community constituted by a shared matter (`quranic:root_000053:B004/m01`); spoken summons (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); totality embracing all parts (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); enrollment in a register (`quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`); reciprocal recompense (`quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`); decisive event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The summons binds collective identity to a particular file without dissolving acts into group abstraction. `كل` closes the account over its parts, and recompense turns the called record into a settlement instrument.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Action is materially joined into a record, copied into durable form, summoned before a collective, and made to speak as evidence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The book is simultaneously an assembled object, a registry, a copied image, an articulate witness, and an instrument of settlement.

parent_channels.name: Final Postures and Enclosures (P3: 45:27-37)

subchannels.name: Kneeling Collectives Become Gathered Bodies
subchannels.scene_or_process: Whole communities are reduced to a common bodily posture, visually resembling gathered heaps awaiting disposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: kneeling on the knees (`quranic:root_000223:B001/m01`); raised heap or bodily mass (`quranic:root_000223:B002/m01`); community gathered by a shared relation (`quranic:root_000053:B004/m01`); totality of all members (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); resurrection and rising of the hour (`quranic:root_001273:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Rising at 45:27 is followed by kneeling at 45:28. The collective remains whole, but sovereignty over posture has shifted: each community is now a gathered bodily mass before the court.

subchannels.name: Mercy Encloses Like a Womb
subchannels.scene_or_process: The faithful are brought across an ingress into a nurturing enclosure whose outcome is rescue and secured good.
subchannels.active_motifs: entry into an interior (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); merciful care (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); womb as enclosing place of growth (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); nurture toward completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); rescue and attainment of good (`quranic:root_001186:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Entry into mercy activates more than an abstract favorable state. The رحم image supplies an interior that protects and develops, lordly nurture governs the process, and `فوز` names emergence as rescue and attainment.

subchannels.name: Fire Is a Refuge Without Exit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A place ordinarily defined by gathering and shelter becomes a compulsory fiery lodging with neither extraction nor assisting party.
subchannels.active_motifs: refuge that gathers its occupants (`quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`); burning fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`); passage to the outside (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); aid against an enemy (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`); pronounced statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `مأوى` retains the form of a place that receives and gathers, but its protective function is reversed. Fire occupies the shelter, the outward route is closed, and no external helper can alter the enclosure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Judgment assigns bodies and collectives a posture, then places them within opposed enclosures from which the final condition is experienced.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 45:28 `أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً`, 45:30 `يُدْخِلُهُمْ ... فِى رَحْمَتِهِ`, and 45:34-35 `مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ`, `لَا يُخْرَجُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mercy takes on the enclosing and generative form of a womb, while fire is named as a shelter whose defining feature is compulsory residence.

parent_channels.name: Missed Appointment and Refused Repair (P3: 45:27-37)

subchannels.name: The Forgotten Meeting Becomes Abandonment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A promised appointment is allowed to leave memory; that lapse becomes active neglect, and the neglect is answered by treating the neglecter as a discarded object.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss from memory (`quranic:root_001501:B001/m01`); deliberate abandonment (`quranic:root_001501:B002/m01`); discarded and unregarded object (`quranic:root_001501:B003/m01`); encounter of two facing parties (`quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`); appointment fixed by promise (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); decisive event or ordeal (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The missed meeting is relational before it is punitive. Memory failure becomes abandonment of an appointment; reciprocal abandonment then materializes the subject as something left behind and no longer regarded.

subchannels.name: No Route Returns to Satisfaction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Reproach would normally invite a change that restores satisfaction, but both the repaired relation and the alternate route are denied.
subchannels.active_motifs: reproach voiced from displeasure (`quranic:root_000977:B005/m01`); return that satisfies the reproacher (`quranic:root_000977:B006/m01`); turning from one road to another (`quranic:root_000977:B007/m01`); passage to the outside (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); pronounced statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `يستعتبون` contains a complete repair script: fault is named, the offender changes course, and satisfaction returns. Its negation closes both the interpersonal process and the spatial alternative, matching the simultaneous denial of exit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A neglected meeting becomes reciprocal abandonment, after which neither explanation, changed route, nor appeasement can reopen the relation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 45:32 `وَعْدَ`, 45:34 `نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ`, and 45:35 `لَا ... يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Forgetting progresses from mental lapse to deliberate discarding, while rejected appeasement includes both relational repair and the attempt to take another road.

parent_channels.name: Surfaces That Conceal and Then Encircle (P3: 45:27-37)

subchannels.name: The Near World's Gleam Conceals Risk
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bright, choice-looking surface draws the inexperienced observer toward a proximate benefit while hiding an uncertain and hazardous outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: conspicuous brightness like a white blaze (`quranic:root_001078:B003/m01`); deception by what shines without stability (`quranic:root_001078:B008/m01`); hazard with an unknown outcome (`quranic:root_001078:B009/m01`); nearness and approach (`quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`); the near or lower world (`quranic:root_000493:B002/m01`); life construed as present benefit (`quranic:root_000383:B013/m01`); ridicule (`quranic:root_001587:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness makes the benefit easy to grasp, while brilliance supplies the misleading signal. The mockery of signs belongs to the same surface judgment: what looks immediately light or advantageous displaces attention from the concealed outcome.

subchannels.name: Deeds Emerge and Close Around Their Makers
subchannels.scene_or_process: Previously unreckoned acts become visible as ugly outcomes and descend around their agents as an enclosing consequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: emergence after concealment (`quranic:root_000097:B001/m01`); harmful consequence descending and surrounding (`quranic:root_000381:B001/m01`); moral ugliness (`quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`); intended action (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`); ridicule returning on its user (`quranic:root_001587:B001/m01`); event made present (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Visibility and enclosure occur in sequence. Deeds first cross from hiddenness into a seen form; what appears then ceases to be an object at a distance and becomes the environment closing around the actors.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A bright or attractive surface can hide its outcome, but concealed action later crosses into visibility and surrounds its actor.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 45:33 `بَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم`, and 45:35 `غَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The world's deceptive sheen and the later appearance of deeds are inverse phases of one visibility process.

parent_channels.name: Sovereign Measure and Collapsing Counterfeit (P3: 45:27-37)

subchannels.name: Kingdom Holds as a Coherent Structure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ownership and rule rest on a force that binds and stabilizes the elevated and lower regions under precise judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: material cohesion and strength (`quranic:root_001444:B001/m01`); possession and power of disposal (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); royal sovereignty (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); height and elevation (`quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`); overhead sky (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); lower ground opposite the sky (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); wisdom that reaches right judgment (`quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`); secure precision (`quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`); inviolable strength (`quranic:root_001008:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `ملك` contributes not only authority but the force by which a structure coheres. Possession, rule, height, ground, wisdom, and precision therefore assemble one governed architecture.

subchannels.name: False Value Loses Capital and Measure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim without stable reality enters the market as idle, unproductive value and ends by losing capital through a deficient measure.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss of trading capital (`quranic:root_000409:B002/m01`); deficient scale or measure (`quranic:root_000409:B003/m01`); lack of reality or stability (`quranic:root_000127:B001/m01`); idleness without useful work (`quranic:root_000127:B005/m01`); resurrection and rising of the hour (`quranic:root_001273:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The rising hour is the moment of valuation. What was already `باطل`, without stable substance or productive work, is exposed as underweight and consumes its own capital.

subchannels.name: Human Inflation Yields to Rightful Majesty
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human self-enlargement is charged as criminal, while praise and true greatness are reassigned to the sovereign source of power.
subchannels.active_motifs: human self-exaltation (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`); rightful divine majesty (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m02`); culpable offense (`quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`); praise for a praiseworthy act (`quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`); inviolable strength (`quranic:root_001008:B001/m01`); lordship and mastery (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The repeated greatness-root performs a same-root role reversal. Human enlargement is exposed as an offense, while `الكبرياء` is restored to the level where power, lordship, and praise make greatness proportionate rather than counterfeit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Legitimate sovereignty holds the world together through right measure, whereas false valuation, idle claim, and self-inflation lose both capital and standing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sovereignty is lexical cohesion, loss is failed trade and short measure, and the same greatness-root distinguishes counterfeit human inflation from rightful majesty.

parent_channels.name: S1. Provision Builds the Recipient (P2: 45:15-26)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Allotted food enters a recipient, builds flesh, yields growth, and becomes both bodily sufficiency and conferred rank.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wholesome and fitting food (`quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`); allotted provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); food entering the body (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); food building flesh (`quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`); crop and fruit yield (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); unowed gift (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); conferred distinction (`quranic:root_001163:B002/m01`); growth and blessing (`quranic:root_000051:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Provision is traced through a physiological process rather than left as possession: food is allotted, ingested, and converted into bodily substance and yield. The same surplus then extends socially as gift and distinction.

parent_channels.name: S2. Promise Between Doubt and Certainty (P3: 45:27-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A declared promise is tested against reality while hearers move among doubt, weak conjecture, knowledge, and stable certainty.
parent_channels.active_motifs: promise that opens expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); agitated doubt (`quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`); acquired knowledge (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`); weak conjecture (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); conviction after an indication (`quranic:root_000969:B001/m01`); stable certainty beyond doubt (`quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`); articulated assertion (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The verse stages an epistemic threshold. Promise points forward, truth fixes correspondence, doubt agitates, conjecture remains underdetermined, and certainty would complete the movement; the speakers stop before that terminal state.

parent_channels.name: S3. Sown Acts and the Criminal Harvest (P3: 45:27-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Work is sown under cover, ripens into gain, is cut from its source, and appears as the dry remainder named crime before payment.
parent_channels.active_motifs: covering seed with soil (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); intended labor (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`); cutting fruit from a tree (`quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`); dry remnants after harvest (`quranic:root_000239:B002/m01`); acquired gain (`quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`); culpable crime (`quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`); reciprocal payment (`quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The crime-root unfolds a complete agricultural economy: cutting, residue, acquisition, and guilt are stages of one harvest. The latent sowing sense of unbelief and the explicit work and recompense anchors make criminal identity the matured yield of prior action.

parent_channels.name: S4. A Wound Comes to a Head and Relapses (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wound swells beyond its bounds, collects pus into a protruding abscess, is probed and cleared, yet can return in a worse state after apparent improvement.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wound swelling and spreading into corruption (`quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`); pus gathering in a wound or abscess (`quranic:root_000282:B003/m01`); bodily abscess or ulcer protruding (`quranic:root_000400:B004/m01`); probing, measuring, and clearing a cranial wound (`quranic:root_000295:B004/m01`); relapse after a wound or illness improves (`quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: This treatment sequence materializes the primary moral reading as pathology. Transgression is a lesion that exceeds its boundary, what “comes” gathers inside it, what “comes out” is the visible abscess, and `حجة` becomes a diagnostic probe rather than argumentative display. The relapse sense of `يغفروا` usefully pressures a superficial account of pardon: an interpersonal claim may be released while an uncleared causal wound can still return.

parent_channels.name: S5. A Charm Redirects Eye and Heart (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A practitioner works a restraining charm, heart-turning bead, or magical knot upon perception and resolve; a counterspell is needed to release the inhibition, while the heart remains the afflicted target.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sorcerers named *al-baṭala* (`quranic:root_000127:B007/m01`); restraining incantation or amulet that seizes the eye or judgment (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); bead or spell that turns the heart from its intention (`quranic:root_000860:B009/m01`); magical knot and its counterspell (`quranic:root_001036:B014/m01`); affliction of the heart (`quranic:root_001248:B011/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The enchantment scene materializes the experienced captivity of the sealed sensorium but usefully pressures an exculpatory reading of it. The surface subject first “takes” signs, protectors, or desire; the sorcerer sense falls on the losing `المبطلون`, and sealing follows the chosen orientation. Self-directed taking functions like the charm, redirected desire like the bead, and the sealed heart like the resulting affliction without transferring agency away from the actor.

parent_channels.name: S6. The Hunt Makes Earning Predatory (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hunters set out, stalk prey under cover of a mount, release trained predatory animals whose capture counts as earning, and inspect the struck quarry to determine whether it has died.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hunters setting out for game (`quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`); stalking prey while concealed by a mount (`quranic:root_000473:B003/m01`); trained hunting birds, beasts, and hounds (`quranic:root_000233:B003/m01`); predatory animals named “earners” (`quranic:root_001296:B003/m01`); inspection of struck prey for death (`quranic:root_001454:B014/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: `اجترحوا` and `كسبت` cease to look like neutral bookkeeping when their latent agents are trained predators that pursue and take quarry. The hunt materializes the primary reading of deeds as purposive acquisitions and pressures a passive notion of wrongdoing: desire organizes pursuit, the capture becomes the hunter’s gain, and the resulting death must finally be faced as the outcome of that pursuit.

parent_channels.name: S7. A Spear Is Aligned from Point to Target (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A sharpened point is fitted to the forepart of a hard, straight spear; the completed instrument is then extended along an open line and aimed at its intended target.
parent_channels.active_motifs: shaft armed with a sharpened spearhead (`quranic:root_000051:B011/m01`); forepart of the spear immediately below its point (`quranic:root_001046:B009/m01`); hard and straight spear (`quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`); spear extended and directed along an open line (`quranic:root_000789:B004/m01`); intentional aiming of an arrow or spear at a target (`quranic:root_000053:B012/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The instrument reframes the primary reading of `شريعة من الأمر` as an aligned vector rather than static terrain. Command arms the shaft, action supplies its forepart, truth gives it sensible straightness, the *sharīʿa* projects it along an open direction, and intention fixes the target. Following the prescribed way is thus keeping component, direction, and end in line; following desires is a deflection of that alignment.

parent_channels.name: S8. Raw Hide Becomes a Joined Vessel (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A craftsperson measures a hide, opens and flays it, scrapes its outer surface, applies a counted tanning dose, and sews the prepared skin into a joined hide or waterskin.
parent_channels.active_motifs: measuring hide before cutting (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); opening and flaying a hide between its legs (`quranic:root_000789:B006/m01`); scraping the outer surface from skin or hide (`quranic:root_000120:B004/m01`); one or two measured doses of tanning agent (`quranic:root_001533:B007/m01`); sewing hide or waterskin to join its pieces (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m02`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The leatherworking sequence reframes the surah’s creation-law-self-book vocabulary as the ordered manufacture of a durable surface. Creation measures before the cut, *sharīʿa* opens the hide, the self-root supplies a counted treatment, and the writing-root closes by stitching. This supports the primary insistence on measured creation and an operative record by materializing order as transformation and joining, not as a loose collection of statements.

parent_channels.name: S9. Approach and Offering at the Sacred House (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A pilgrim forms an intention toward a revered House, repeatedly approaches the fixed destination, carries an offering to its sanctuary, and completes the prescribed rites.
parent_channels.active_motifs: pilgrims intentionally heading toward the Sacred House (`quranic:root_000053:B012/m02`); pilgrimage as repeated approach to a revered destination (`quranic:root_000295:B001/m01`); the Kaaba or Sacred House as a named building (`quranic:root_000156:B003/m01`); livestock or property offered to the sanctuary (`quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`); completion of worship and rites (`quranic:root_001237:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The rite supports the primary demand to follow a prescribed way by giving guidance a destination, bodily approach, transferred property, and completion. It also reframes the contested `حجة`: argument remains a verbal claim, while pilgrimage enacts repeated approach; `هدى` becomes an offering carried to the sanctuary, and the community-root supplies directed intention. Guidance is thereby tested by arrival and completed practice rather than by possession of a claim.

parent_channels.name: S10. Distant Rain Is Routed Into a Basin (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A flood arrives from rain-fed country, distant feeder channels carry it toward dry ground, a cut watercourse directs its motion, and a low basin receives and retains it.
parent_channels.active_motifs: flood arriving from a rained-on country to a dry one (`quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`); distant ravines feeding a collecting place (`quranic:root_001510:B007/m01`); canal directing water toward a basin (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); low or fortified basin collecting standing water (`quranic:root_000282:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The circuit materializes descent, provision, and subjection as delivery rather than mere abundance. Rain may fall elsewhere, but benefit reaches dry ground only through feeder, channel, and receptive basin. The water sense of `نواصر` also sharpens the final absence of helpers: these channels truly convey an external resource into need, whereas no rescuing conduit reaches the occupants of the terminal enclosure.

parent_channels.name: S11. A Plow Team Prepares the First Watering (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two oxen are coupled by the long rods of a plow yoke, the plowman grips the standing wooden handle, and the opened ground receives its first irrigation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: paired oxen and the long rods of their plow yoke (`quranic:root_000741:B015/m01`); wooden plow handle held by the plowman (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); first watering after tillage (`quranic:root_000393:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Cultivation makes reception an organized bodily operation: paired traction opens the ground, a held implement governs direction, and watering begins the yield. This supports the surah's work-and-harvest reading while usefully pressing the seal at 45:23. Lexically, a `ختم` can inaugurate cultivation with the first watering; here the sensory field is instead closed where receptive ground would be opened.

parent_channels.name: S12. An Outstanding Debt Is Pursued to Settlement (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A written acknowledgment preserves a right, an unpaid remainder follows earlier installments, its claimant pursues it, collection is demanded, and payment closes the account.
parent_channels.active_motifs: written instrument acknowledging a right (`quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`); remainder of an unpaid debt or right (`quranic:root_000186:B003/m01`); creditor pursuing a right, blood-price, or property (`quranic:root_000175:B005/m01`); demanding and collecting a debt (`quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`); paying a debt and receiving the due right (`quranic:root_001237:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The practice materializes the personal account and speaking record as a live claim rather than stored description. A documented right survives partial payment, follows its liable party through a claimant, and ends only in exact collection. Recompense therefore resembles settlement of an attributable balance: delay does not detach it from its bearer.

parent_channels.name: S13. The Lot Arrow Comes Out for Its Owner (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Chance arrows are kept together in a leather holder, the fifth lot is identified, fortune governs expectation, and the emerging arrow declares its owner the winner.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather holder containing divination or gambling arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); fifth arrow of the game of lots (`quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`); luck or fortune as an allotted condition (`quranic:root_000560:B006/m01`); winning arrow coming out for its owner (`quranic:root_001186:B001/m02`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The game usefully pressures any reading of `فوز` or provision as lucky allotment. Its result is produced by a concealed draw, but the surah assigns outcome to an identified self, copied deeds, and just recompense. The lexical winning lot thus supplies the contrast: final attainment belongs to accountable action rather than fortune.

parent_channels.name: S14. Patterned Voice Becomes Pleasurable Performance (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A metrical poem is sung or recited with vocal modulation, its phrases are returned as refrains, and a hearer receives the result as pleasurable sound.
parent_channels.active_motifs: metrical *rajaz* poem and its performance (`quranic:root_000542:B002/m01`); song, vocal modulation, and softened recitation (`quranic:root_001110:B003/m01`); repeated or ornamented voice in recitation, singing, or call (`quranic:root_000544:B007/m01`); pleasurable listening and the singer's beautiful voice (`quranic:root_000741:B007/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The performance materializes why acoustic reception need not become obedience. Meter, modulation, repetition, and pleasure can complete a satisfying sound-event while leaving its directive content unfollowed. This supports the surah's distinction between hearing recited signs and allowing what is heard to govern action.

parent_channels.name: S15. Soot Is Worked Into Retraced Lines (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Smoke pigment is prepared from a wick or fat, skin is pricked and dusted with it, and the dark lines are retraced until the inscription holds.
parent_channels.active_motifs: soot or antimony pigment made from wick or fat smoke (`quranic:root_001564:B008/m01`); pricked skin dusted with tattoo pigment (`quranic:root_001564:B008/m02`); tattoo or inscription lines repeatedly blackened (`quranic:root_000544:B009/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Tattooing materializes the surah's record and seal imagery as an inscription fixed by incision, deposited matter, and repeated tracing. It also pressures a reading of the seal as erasure of agency: durable marking is the accumulated result of repeated operations, paralleling the record that copies what its subjects kept doing.

parent_channels.name: S16. A Joined Wall Falls Piece by Piece (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wall or house is made by joining separate components, then structural failure travels through those relations and brings one part down after another.
parent_channels.active_motifs: building by joining parts into a house, wall, or structure (`quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`); cascading fall and demolition one part after another (`quranic:root_000478:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Construction and demolition are exact directional reversals: joining distributes support, while cascading failure transmits collapse. The scene materializes the contrast between sovereign cohesion and counterfeit alliance or rank. A collective can be assembled from adjacent parts without possessing the force that keeps those parts standing.

parent_channels.name: S17. A Full Pot Is Tempered and Lifted From Fire (Whole Surah: 45:1-37)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A large, full pot is exposed to cooking heat until a substance loses some of its force, then an operator uses a protective cloth to lower the vessel from the hearth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: large pot figured as gathered fullness (`quranic:root_000259:B012/m01`); cooking that weakens or tempers a substance (`quranic:root_001454:B002/m01`); heat-protective cloth used to remove a pot from fire (`quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Ordinary fire is bounded by vessel, useful transformation, and an available means of removal. That complete handling scene reverses the final enclosure in 45:34-35: fire itself becomes the lodging, exposure is not a tempering process, and no operator or intermediary extracts those gathered within it.

parent_channels.name: Hidden Conversion Returns as Yield (P1, P2, P3)
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An input enters a receptive medium, changes out of sight, and returns as a yield attributable to what entered.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 45:5 `فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ`; P2 45:16 `رَزَقْنَٰهُم`, `ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ`; P3 45:28 `تَعْمَلُونَ`, `تُجْزَوْنَ` and 45:31 `مُّجْرِمِينَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Atmospheric circulation, bodily nutrition, and moral recompense share not a topic but the same transformation architecture.

parent_channels.name: The Address Changes Role Into Witness (P1, P2, P3)
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Ordered communication persists while its role advances from addressed sign, to governing norm, to testimony that speaks in judgment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 45:2 `تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ` and 45:6 `نَتْلُوهَا`; P2 45:18 `شَرِيعَةٍ`, `فَٱتَّبِعْهَا`; P3 45:29 `كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ`, `نَسْتَنسِخُ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The message does not merely recur across the surah; its legal role changes as the hearer’s opportunity changes.

parent_channels.name: Closure Reverses Direction (P1, P2, P3)
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Refusal first closes the person against an incoming sign; judgment reverses the boundary so hidden outputs emerge and consequence closes around that person.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same boundary logic changes direction and grammatical subject: the actor closes reception, deeds cross into visibility, and consequence becomes the enclosing environment.

parent_channels.name: Enabled Motion Narrows Into Irreversible Destination (P1, P2, P3)
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement begins as enabled passage, becomes accountable route selection, and ends when alternate passage, repair, and exit are no longer available.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; P1 45:12 `لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ`; P2 45:18 `شَرِيعَةٍ`, `فَٱتَّبِعْهَا`, `أَهْوَآءَ` and 45:23 `أَضَلَّهُ`; P3 45:35 `لَا يُخْرَجُونَ`, `لَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Subjection and guidance create mobility, but that mobility is progressively converted into responsibility for direction.
